info.title: CNothing V4
info.description: OAuth and credential-injecting proxy infrastructure for AI agents. Agents receive grants and sanitized API responses, never OAuth tokens or client secrets. Prefer the MCP endpoint at /mcp for agent use. Human approval supports the Console and the CNothing iOS authenticator with APNs and device-bound signatures.

tags.name: Agent
tags.description: Bearer-authenticated operations used by an AI agent.

tags.name: User
tags.description: Browser or iOS operations authenticated by a CNothing user session.

tags.name: iOS
tags.description: Pairing, APNs registration, polling, and device-bound approval.

tags.name: Operator
tags.description: Human administrative operations. Require a signed-in CNothing user with role=admin. The service bearer token is not a Console login.

tags.name: Service
tags.description: Trusted machine operations authenticated by KEYSERVICE_BEARER_TOKEN (or CN_SERVICE_TOKEN). Bootstrap and recovery only.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: GitHub and OIDC browser sign-in. Admins and users share this login.

agentToken.description: Agent token issued once by POST /v4/agents. Configure it as CNOTHING_AGENT_TOKEN for the stdio MCP client, or as the Authorization bearer for hosted MCP/HTTP.

userSession.name: cnothing_user_session
userSession.description: Browser session cookie. Device sessions may also use their bearer session token.

adminToken.description: Deprecated name for the service credential configured by KEYSERVICE_BEARER_TOKEN or CN_SERVICE_TOKEN. Not a human Console login. Used for POST /v4/admin/bootstrap.

serviceToken.description: Service credential configured by KEYSERVICE_BEARER_TOKEN or CN_SERVICE_TOKEN. Bootstrap, recovery, and trusted automation only.

hosts.description: Optional API host allowlist. Omit to use the provider's safe defaults.

reason.description: Short human-readable explanation of why the agent needs access.

user_id.description: Optional iOS push target. Pass a GitHub username, github:username, a u_ share code, or a previously resolved CNothing user ID directly. Do not call or invent a user lookup endpoint.

callback_url.description: Optional public HTTPS URL notified after approval or denial.

issuer.description: Optional. Propose an unknown provider from its issuer. You may also pass an https issuer as provider.

discovery_url.description: Optional OIDC discovery or RFC 8414 metadata URL used with a provider proposal.

url.description: Must be HTTPS and match the grant host allowlist.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries of a side-effecting call reuse the same Transaction.

public_key_jwk.description: P-256 public key; the private key remains in the iOS Secure Enclave.

connection_id.description: Required when approving a delegation. Omitted for transaction approvals.

require_approval.description: When true, the minted Mandate opts into Transaction Intent: later non-GET proxy_request calls need a per-action approval.

signature.description: Base64url P-256 signature from the paired device.

get.description: Call this before request_access. It returns public provider metadata only.

get.summary: List the provider registry without exposing secrets
get.description: Each item includes stored status plus registry_status (discovered | unverified | reviewed | active | disabled), source, registration_method, and the last validation result.

post.summary: Propose a provider from untrusted discovery metadata
post.description: Looks up the registry by slug or issuer. If missing, runs OIDC / OAuth authorization-server discovery through the same SSRF checks as the proxy and inserts an unconfigured row for operator review. Does not activate the provider. MCP tools are unchanged.

patch.summary: Review, activate, disable, or update OAuth metadata
Store provider client credentials in the Vault

200.description: Credentials updated; secret values are never returned.

post.description: Use the returned approval_url exactly as provided. If user_id resolves to a paired user, CNothing also sends an iOS push. The agent must then poll GET /v4/access-requests/{id}; it must not browse, rewrite, or POST to the approval URL. If the provider is unknown, pass issuer or discovery_url (or an https issuer as provider) to create a registry proposal; the response status is then provider_review_required until an operator activates it.

201.description: Pending request, exact human approval URL, and push/onboarding status.

get.summary: Poll request status or load approval details

200.description: Request status. Once approved, the agent receives grant_id, not an OAuth token.

get.summary: List pending approvals for the signed-in user
get.description: Used by the iOS authenticator as a resilient fallback when APNs delivery is delayed. Each item is an ApprovalRequest; today's rows have type=delegation.

post.summary: Issue a one-time device approval challenge
post.description: Only a session created by device pairing may request this nonce.

201.description: Nonce and expiry for Secure Enclave signing.

post.summary: Approve access and create a scoped grant

201.description: Delegation mints a Grant. A transaction approval authorizes the existing Mandate and returns transaction_id; no new Grant is minted. Paired-device sessions require a valid challenge signature.

200.description: Request denied. Paired-device sessions require a valid challenge signature.

post.summary: Call an approved third-party HTTPS API
post.description: CNothing injects the OAuth credential server-side, strips agent-supplied credential headers, enforces method and host constraints, evaluates the mandate's opt-in policy, blocks SSRF, redacts secrets, and audits the call. When the mandate set require_approval, a write returns status=approval_required with the same approval_url shape as request_access; after the principal approves, retry the same proxy_request to execute.

200.description: Sanitized upstream status, headers, and body.

get.summary: List grants visible to the current principal
get.description: A grant is the v4 representation of a Mandate: delegated authority from a principal to an agent. The response keeps allowed_hosts / allowed_methods and adds principal, constraints, actions, issued_at, and revoked_at.

patch.summary: Update mandate constraints on a grant
patch.description: The granting user can opt a live Mandate into require_approval so later writes become Transaction Intents. GET is never gated.

get.summary: List the user's third-party OAuth connections

post.summary: Create a short-lived iOS pairing code

post.description: Consumes the code, registers the device public key, and returns a device session token. No existing session is required.

201.description: Paired device and device session token.

200.description: Devices without private keys or full push tokens.

delete.summary: Revoke a paired device and disable push

post.summary: Register or rotate an APNs device token
Issue a short-lived u_ share code for agent targeting

200.description: Canonical user ID and share-code status.

post.description: Returns the agent token once. Store it in a secret manager; CNothing stores only its hash.

201.description: Agent and one-time plaintext access token.

200.description: GitHub and configured OIDC sign-in methods.

302.description: Set the user session cookie and redirect.

302.description: Set the user session cookie and redirect.

get.summary: Sign in through a configured OAuth provider

get.description: Returns the signed-in Human user_id and the server-side role (user or admin). Role is never taken from the client.

200.description: Authentication status, user ID, and role.

post.summary: Promote the first Human user to admin
post.description: One-time bootstrap. Requires the service credential and a user that already exists. Disabled once any admin exists. Does not create a Human session.

409.description: Bootstrap disabled because an admin already exists.

post.summary: Grant admin role to an existing user
Remove admin role from a user
post.description: Refuses to remove the last remaining admin.

200.description: User is now a regular user.

post.summary: Enable a provider for browser sign-in
post.description: Registers the provider in the provider registry (or upgrades the existing entry with the same slug) and marks it usable as a console login identity provider.
